tie_policy: stable original node order; report floating-point rank violations, compare 12-decimal canonical ranks separately without replacing original values

empirical_module_rule.example_rule: two largest eligible discovery modules, ties ascending moduleID
empirical_module_rule.significance: none; descriptive density and within-module connectivity rank agreement

simulation.precision_goal: worst-case normal half-width <=.13 for [0,1] dataset-mean endpoints at R60; actual MCSE also reported
simulation.latent_loadings: each module linearly spaced .35 to .85 times scale
simulation.nuisance_loadings: amplitude times linspace(.2,1.2,120) reversed within alternate modules
simulation.hubs: three largest loading nodes per module =12; verify population nuisance-free association ordering
simulation.module_algorithm: normalized spectral clustering known K4, precomputed hard/soft adjacency, assign_labels cluster_qr, fixed seed; algorithmic disconnected-graph warnings logged
simulation.common_support: soft weight restricted to same sample reference hard edges; CV descriptive only
simulation.independent_reproducibility: two independently generated samples per dataset, same n; both reconstructed with same settings
simulation.null_truth: no planted signal; latent hub and module recovery undefined; report apparent stability and independent reproducibility

additional_cohort.eligibility: primary colorectal carcinoma tissue miRNA; untreated preferred; metadata and processed expression inspectable
additional_cohort.selection_order: metadata specimen/condition similarity; explicit persons; larger n; ascending accession; no network outcomes

annotation: targeted primary-source interpretation of predeclared largest modules only; no enrichment unless independent accessible target coverage and bias-aware null feasible
